name: Mukhyamantri Baristha Bunakar and Karigara Sahayata Yojana
benefit: The financial assistance for weavers & ancillary workers /handicraft artisan shall be as follows: **S.No****Category****Age of the Beneficiary****Quantum of Assistance (in Rs.)**1FemaleMore than 40 years to less than 80 years20002MaleMore than 50 years to less than 80 years20003Both Female &amp;amp; Male80 years or more2500
_eligibility_text:
1. He/ She must be a permanent resident/domicile of Odisha.
   1. Weavers &amp; Ancillary Workers and Handicraft Artisans to be eligible for assistance under the scheme should be 40 years &amp; above in case of female and 50 years &amp; above in case of male.
   1. His/ Her name must be in the final list of weavers &amp; ancillary workers and artisans as per the latest survey. The National awardees, Stale awardees, Kalakruti awardees, Tantakruti Awardees including Design/ Merit certificate awardees in Handloom &amp; Handicraft sectors will also be eligible irrespective of their names placed in the above survey list, if they are otherwise eligible. The beneficiaries out of above survey list may be screened further by HT&amp;H Department officials in the district or other such officer as would be appointed by the District Collector.
   1. Only one member of the family shall be eligible to get the assistance under this Scheme irrespective of the number of family members fulfilling the eligibility criteria.
   1. The annual income of the family should not exceed Rs. 1,00,000/- (Rupees One Lakh) The Income Certificate issued by Concerned Tahasildar/ Additional Tahasildar or any other competent authority of Revenue Department is acceptable.
   1. Govt. employees, lncome Tax payers, Retired Govt. employees of Govt. of India and/or any State Government will not be eligible to get the assistance from the scheme.
   1. A Handloom weaver/ Ancillary worker/ Handicraft Artisan wilt not be eligible if he/ she is availing similar benefits under any other scheme of the State Government like Madhubabu Pension Yojana, Mukhyamantri Kalakar Sahayata Yojana, etc., and any other scheme of Government of India.
   1. A Handloom weaver/ Ancillary worker/ Handicraft Artisan will not be eligible if he/ she has been convicted of any criminal offence.
   1. Financial Assistance under this scheme to a beneficiary shall be effective from the date of approval of District Level Selection Committee.
